assumptions: NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's rpsblast against the bundled SMART PSSMs.
limits: SMART's 1,011 models only; all of CDD is rps_blast_cdd.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which SMART domain models does this protein hit?

description: rpsblast, run on this machine: find conserved domains in a protein against NCBI's SMART domain models (1,011 PSSMs from CDD). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's algorithms, checked against the rpsblast program on every bundled protein. Nothing is sent anywhere; for all of CDD use rps_blast_cdd, which goes to NCBI.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

evalue.description: report alignments with E at most this (`-evalue`); BLAST's default is 10.

protein.description: the protein, one-letter codes; wire it from translate_sequence or read it off a CDS.

source.description: where the SMART database is read from: 'bundled' (a byte-identical copy of NCBI's file) or 'ncbi' (NCBI's FTP site, now). Advanced.

name: rps_blast_smart

domains.description: every SMART domain hit, best first: accession, shortName, title, profileLength and each HSP's residue coordinates, model coordinates, score, bits, E-value, identities, positives, gaps and aligned strings
